The '''Selvatas system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that contained the planet [[Drash-So]]. During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Drash-so contained an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] camp that was run by the [[One Sith]]. [[Ania Solo]] and her lover [[Ramid]] were imprisoned at that labor camp during the last years of that conflict. Ania managed to escape the prison camp and secure passage offworld with the help of [[AG-37]], a kindly [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] who had known her ancestor [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].
